name: Vapi
target_customers: "Voice agents for builders" — developers and enterprises needing large-scale deployment (Amazon Ring, Intuit, ServiceTitan named)

entry_price.plan_name: No Success Package (pay as you go)
entry_price.notes: $0 to start, pre-paid, $0.05/min Vapi hosting; $5 free credits, 1 phone number, 4 concurrent calls. Core plan $29/month. STT, LLM, TTS passed through at provider cost; telephony charged by provider (e.g. Twilio outbound $0.014/min).

per_minute_from.notes: Vapi hosting fee only; excludes transcriber, LLM, voice and telephony. Page example at 1,000 min/month totals $82–$129/month (~$0.08–0.13/min).

hindi_hinglish.evidence: Multilingual docs give provider language counts (Google STT 125+, Azure TTS 140+) but do not name Hindi or Hinglish

indic_languages.evidence: No Indian languages named in Vapi multilingual docs

outbound_inbound.evidence: Docs cover inbound phone calling plus outbound calling and outbound Campaigns

live_transfer.evidence: Transfer Call tool with blind and warm transfer modes, incl. assistant-based warm transfer

mid_call_actions.evidence: Function tools, API Request tool, MCP tools, built-in Google Calendar/Sheets/Slack tools during calls

no_code_builder.evidence: Dashboard configures assistants, but visual Workflows are being retired in favour of Squads; product pitched to builders/developers

api_webhooks.evidence: API-native; server URL webhooks/server events, campaign webhooks, phone number hooks

built_in_crm.evidence: Outbound Campaigns take contact data lists; no native lead pipeline documented

lead_source_connectors.evidence: Integrations via Zapier, Make, n8n, GoHighLevel; no native Meta/Google lead-form triggers documented

whatsapp_followup.evidence: Inbound SMS and SMS chat documented; no WhatsApp page in docs

post_call_analysis.evidence: Call analysis auto-produces summary, structured data and success evaluation after each call

call_qa.evidence: Monitoring creates issues on thresholds with email/Slack/webhook alerts; scorecards auto-score calls

human_call_intelligence.evidence: Not documented; analysis applies to Vapi agent calls

telephony_included.evidence: Free Vapi numbers are US area codes, inbound only; other countries need imported Twilio/Telnyx/DIDWW/SIP numbers

languages_claimed: Not stated as a count by Vapi; docs cite providers e.g. Google STT 125+ languages, Azure 140+ TTS languages
india_compliance: None stated. Free numbers US-only; India requires importing a number from Twilio, Telnyx, DIDWW or SIP trunk.

scale.customers_claimed: 1M+ developers, 2.5M+ agents launched, 1 billion calls supported (homepage)

notable_2025_2026: Raised a $50M Series B led by Peak XV in May 2026, bringing total funding to $72M (per SiliconANGLE).

name: Retell AI
target_customers: "AI Voice Agent Platform for Automating Phone Calls" — healthcare, financial services, insurance, logistics, retail, travel, debt collection

entry_price.notes: "Starts at $0.07–$0.31/min" for voice agents. Breakdown: Retell voice infra $0.055/min + LLM (e.g. GPT 5 mini $0.008/min) + TTS ($0.015/min standard voices) + Retell telephony $0.015/min (no charge for SIP/custom telephony). $10 free credits; 20 free concurrent calls, then $8/concurrency/month.

per_minute_from.notes: Lowest headline rate; calculator example $0.11/min all-in (LLM $0.04 + infra $0.055 + TTS $0.015). Add-ons: KB +$0.005/min, AI QA $0.10/min after 100 free min.
